title: PDF change-highlight late-history-read failure and repair

failure.summary: Holding the real workspace:version before-PDF reply until the AI completion UI settled prevented Show changes from ever appearing. The comparison was discarded because src/App.tsx gated the late reply on activeRun, which completion had already cleared.
failure.evidence: lifecycle worktree test-results/pdf-highlight-Xt0uDy (result.json, exact harness bytes, exports, screenshots)

repair.change: src/App.tsx now keys the late before-PDF read on the applied project id and revision instead of activeRun, so a valid late reply completes while a project switch or newer build still discards it. PdfPreview also drops a comparison whose after-bytes differ from the displayed PDF and clamps change navigation to the surviving page count.
repair.harness: scripts/test-pdf-highlight-smoke.mjs (promoted from the retained fixture; npm run test:pdf-highlight)

checks: Real AI edit and two-page image review; normalized regions, timed fade, replay, zoom, change navigation and byte-identical highlight-free export.
The AI-edited source is saved to disk before another project is opened.
Real before-version reply held until the AI completion UI settled, then released.
